methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
The UN System Chief Executives Board (CEB) publishes session reports (HLCM, HLCP, HRN, DTN) and annual overviews at https://unsceb.org/content/reports. It is a server-rendered Drupal site: a plain GET returns real HTML with direct PDF anchors, so the listing is reliably scrapable.

## Search
No JSON/REST search API. The documented site search endpoint https://unsceb.org/search?q={query} returned an empty/JS-driven body on probing and did not yield server-rendered result links, so 'search' is NOT claimed. The safe strategy is to browse and paginate the /content/reports listing rather than rely on the search box.

## Filters
The navigation exposes taxonomy filters as URL params (e.g. ?field_mechanism[94]=94, ?field_product[5]=5), but these are opaque numeric term IDs, not human-friendly date/type filters, so no filterSchema is declared. Pagination uses ?page=N.

## Download
Reports appear as direct .pdf links under /sites/default/files/. Download is a plain GET of the resolved absolute URL. Filenames encode the body and session (e.g. 'CEB.2026.3 - HLCM 51st Session - Final Report_published.pdf').

## Metadata & Enrichment
No per-document metadata endpoint. Session, body and approximate date are parsed from anchor text and filename. No enrichment adapter needed.

## Limitations
List browsing is solid and server-rendered, but keyword search is not usable via a simple URL (search page appears JS-driven / returned no scrapable links). Coverage is therefore best via paginated browse of /content/reports and sibling category pages (/content/notes etc.).
probeNotes: WebFetch of https://unsceb.org/content/reports returned server-rendered HTML with direct .pdf links under /sites/default/files/ and ?page=N pagination. WebFetch of https://unsceb.org/search?q=climate returned an empty body (no server-rendered results), so search capability was dropped.
